body:
Ava: Heads-up — RCA draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/rca/inc-921. We need a quick ownership sweep for the action items before tomorrow's sync.
Diego: reading now, will flag anything ambiguous.
Priya: can we split infra vs app-level? I can take infra items if Diego wants app.
Diego: yes pls, I’ll own app migrations and postmortem writeup.
Tom: I can own the canary runbook + rollback play.
Ava: sweet. Owning matrix draft (who owns what) — filling in tentative dates, pls confirm.
Priya: quick Q — cache invalidation task references a DBA migration. Who is that assigned to?
Diego: I thought Sangeeta was looping in DB? She mentioned a schema change in the PR comments.
Ava: Sangeeta is out today, tagged her last night but no reply. If she's gone we should pick a fallback.
Tom: fallback = Jon (infra db owner) or Priya if Jon unavailable.
Priya: I can be fallback for now, but need a final green light before changing prod schema.
OpsBot: Incident bot: RCA draft v2 uploaded by Ava at 2025-03-27T09:12Z. Actions extracted: 6 items.
Ava: Ok, listing action items here so we have a single source in thread. Please reply with owner + ETA or "defer".
Ava: Action A1 — Reduce token cache TTL for keyset refresh to 30s (was 300s) — owner: Diego? ETA: ___
Diego: A1 accepted. ETA 2025-03-28 EOD. Will include a feature flag.
Ava: Action A2 — DB schema minor: user_tokens.idx add col hashed_id — owner: Sangeeta? fallback: Priya — ETA: ___
Priya: A2 fallback accepted pending Sangeeta. Tentative ETA 2025-04-02.
Tom: Action A3 — Canary plan + automated rollback script — owner: Tom — ETA 2025-03-28 morning.
Tom: Plan includes the rollback curl, putting here: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api/run-canary -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' -d '{"percent":10,"model":"open-12b"}'```
Ava: Action A4 — Add KV prefix caching to runtime for prefix X — owner: Diego — ETA: 2025-04-04
Diego: A4 accepted, but note: will need a kernel recompile window; booking maintenance slot 2025-04-03.
Ava: Action A5 — Update runbook docs + add postmortem summary paragraph — owner: Diego + PM review — ETA: 2025-03-29
Diego: A5 accepted, will draft and ping PM for review.
Ava: Action A6 — Customer comms draft for affected tenants — owner: Priya — ETA: 2025-03-30
Priya: A6 accepted. Will share draft by 2025-03-29 for reviews.
Tom: Heads-up — the canary script references feature flag `feature.reduce_token_ttl`. Make sure flag gating is in place before canary.
Diego: flag is ready in config-service, I’ll coordinate rollout with Tom.
Ava: blockers?
Priya: blocker = Sangeeta OOO for A2. If she doesn't reply by EOD tomorrow we should escalate to Jon.
Diego: blocker = kernel compile queue — might shift ETA by a day if queue fills. I’ll update if that happens.
Tom: blocker = automation infra has a transient credential rotation bug. I opened a ticket 54321 assigned to infra-sre. If not fixed, I’ll run canary manually.
Ava: thanks. For traceability, please add PR links in the RCA doc when you create changes.
Diego: will add PRs and include `#inc-921` in titles.
Priya: I’ll add comms doc link and owners table once draft is ready.
Ava: final ask — everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm owner+ETA in this thread. I’ll take the reactions as sign-off for tomorrow's sync.
Diego: ✅
Tom: ✅
Priya: ✅
Ava: ✅
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: owners sweep reminder in 12h.
Ava: Great, filing these into the action tracker now. If owners need to shift dates, update this thread so PM sees the change.
Diego: noted.
Priya: noted.
Tom: noted, will ping infra-sre about the credential ticket.
Ava: thanks all — closing thread for now, will reopen if any ETA slides.
